guitar.notes: Jack White's red Airline (JB Hutto/Montgomery Ward) guitar is iconic and well documented from the White Stripes/Raconteurs era.

tone.target: jangly Vox-style edge-of-breakup with bright bite
tone.profile: jangly Vox-style edge-of-breakup with bright bite
tone.summary: A clean signal chain utilizing a slight boost and Chorus to enhance the jangle, followed by the UK 45 amp model and US Vintage 2x12 cab for a bright, articulate, edge-of-breakup sound with room ambience.
corrections: shift from mid-gain rock to chimey low-gain

rig.name: The Raconteurs - Steady, As She Goes - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain rhythmic clarity.
Provide a light, bright boost and slight grit for the 'edge-of-breakup' sound.
Bypass or use a clean boost if needed; keeping the gain low and focused on pre-amp coloration.
Add subtle width and 'jangle' to the chiming guitar tone.
Emulate the Vox AC30 sound, providing bright, articulate chime and natural breakup.
Select a bright, focused cabinet that complements the Vox tone and enhances clarity.
Brighten the high end and maintain definition while keeping the low end tight.
Add a subtle sense of space and depth without muddying the jangly tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the natural room sound of a Vox AC30.

proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is too generic; use a single-speaker IR to better emulate the classic Vox sound and room ambience.
